messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: sustained p95 generation latency >1200ms for tenant corpY in dedicated-pool-usw2 (VPC). Observability gap detected: traces for tenant=corpY missing from trace-store-usw2. Creating incident INC-2025-1752103456. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/obs-gap (incidents playbook)

ryan_oncall: on it. I can see elevated queue times hitting the dedicated pool. Are we sure traces are missing and not just delayed? :eyes: 

joel_eng_runtime: checked the trace indexer, query for tag tenant:corpY returns empty. other tenants show spans fine. tracer logs show 403 when write tried at 03:07:12 UTC (permission?)

maria_sre: quick customer impact check: do we have errors surfaced to corpY (prod)?

amy_sa: corpY support just pinged earlier — they reported timeouts on a subset of completions (prod and staging). They asked if this is a tenant isolation issue. Customer is on Dedicated + VPC, reserved pool corpY-ded-usw2.

anil_infra: pulling VPC flow logs now. I see egress to trace-store-usw2 S3 bucket with OK responses until 03:06:59, then repeated TCP RST from our collector IPs -> nat-gw-12. Not seeing auth failures to S3.

ryan_oncall: can someone run an internal log fetch for recent spans and indexer errors? Trying:

```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $OBS_TOKEN" "https://obs.internal/api/v1/logs?service=tracer&tenant=corpY&since=15m"
```

joel_eng_runtime: ran that. response: { "hits": 0, "errors": ["indexer: tenant-shard not found for tenant corpY"] }

beth_support: I DM'd corpY with incident number and asked for any recent change on their side. They're confirming none. They want ETA.

maria_sre: hypotheses: 1) tenant shard mapping for traces got garbage collected / evicted 2) routing table for trace-writes lost the corpY mapping 3) indexer auth misconfiguration during a recent deploy. We need to confirm which.

ryan_oncall: i'm going to attempt a short mitigation: fallback routing of trace writes and read queries to the shared-trace-cluster (read-only acceptable for visibility) while we debug the dedicated shard. Will need product/SA ok for fallback for a paid enterprise tenant.

amy_sa: corpY needs visibility ASAP. Approve temporary fallback. Please log it in the incident doc and set TTL to 30m.

joel_eng_runtime: prepping command. Will set routing flag and restart trace-writer only for corpY.

```
# enable fallback routing
redwood routing set --service traces --tenant corpY --target shared-trace-cluster --ttl 30m --note "obs-gap fallback"

# restart writer process for corpY
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deploy/trace-writer-corpY
```

anil_infra: note: packet drops from nat-gw-12 looked transient, but indexer metadata store (etcd) shows deletes in the tenant-mapping keyspace around 03:06:55 UTC. I'll snapshot etcd values now.

ryan_oncall: executing routing command now.

joel_eng_runtime: got this output from routing service: { "status": "ok", "before": "dedicated-trace-shard-corpY", "after": "shared-trace-cluster", "ttl": "30m" }

ryan_oncall: restarted trace-writer; logs show writer now successfully POSTing spans to shared-trace-cluster. Running the curl fetch again...

joel_eng_runtime: new fetch returns spans (pushed within seconds). trace search now surfaces traces for corpY. :thumbsup:

beth_support: updated corpY (staging now showing traces; prod partial). They appreciate quick mitigation but asked for root cause.

maria_sre: marking mitigation as implemented. Next: root cause triage — who owns etcd tenant-mapping deletes? Could be deploy automation

anil_infra: commit in infra-ops had a script that pruned tenant mappings if a healthcheck failed. Looks like it fired because the indexer returned 500 for a minute during a config rollout. I'm pulling the deploy timeline now.

amy_sa: customer escalation risk — corpY legal/compliance may want audit trail for any tenant mapping changes. We'll need to capture who/what triggered delete and ensure we have an approved rollback plan.

ryan_oncall: handing lead to sandhya_oncall for the rest of the on-call window. sandhya, I left the fallback live for 30m; please extend if needed.

sandhya_oncall: taking over. Thanks @ryan_oncall. I'll coordinate with anil to restore dedicated shard safely and confirm permissions. Also will create follow-up tasks: (1) prevent automated prune for enterprise-vpc tenants (2) add alert for missing tenant shards (3) runbook update for fallback routing.

joel_eng_runtime: action item: add guard in deploy automation to skip prune for tenants marked 'reserved' or 'dedicated'.

anil_infra: saving etcd snapshot and audit log; found the prune job ID: infra-prune-2025-04-23-0306. Adding as evidence in incident doc.

beth_support: corpY asked for an ETA on dedicated shard restore.

maria_sre: ETA to restore dedicated shard and verify: ~45-60 minutes given indexer snapshot restore and validation. Will post updates here.

incident-bot: Incident severity updated to Sev2. Incident INC-2025-1752103456 assigned to oncall-sandhya_oncall. Pager suppression enabled for low-noise channels.

beth_support: emailed corpY summary, mitigation steps, and that we're working on permanent restore. they requested access to the audit log — passing to security for redaction.

sandhya_oncall: I'll keep the fallback in place until the shard is fully restored and we have traces+metrics parity. tagging @joel_eng_runtime @anil_infra for restore steps.

ryan_oncall: thanks team. logging handoff notes in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2025-1752103456

joel_eng_runtime: leaving a short snippet of the diagnostic commands we ran for postmortem:

```
# check tenant shard mapping
etcdctl get /tenant-mapping/corpY --prefix --print-value-only

# verify writer connectivity
curl -s -XPOST https://shared-trace-cluster.internal/ingest -H "tenant: corpY" -d @sample_span.json -v
```

maria_sre: good work. follow-ups assigned in the incident doc. I'll kick off the postmortem once shard restore + audit log delivery complete. :memo: 

beth_support: I'll keep corpY updated every 30m and escalate if they want a call.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-1752103456 updated: mitigation applied (trace fallback), owner: sandhya_oncall, status: investigating.
